correctness.rationale: For all n≥2, d|n,d≥2,m=n/d and each integer k∈[0,n-1], the actual geometric fixed-point realization of N(n,k) consists of barycentric orbit-saturated faces (not vertexwise fixed faces). Nonempty B⊆Z/mZ has orbit union U(B) with largest cyclic gap g_n(U(B))=g_m(B)≤m. Since S lies in a k+1 interval iff g_n(S)≥n−k, fixed complexes are empty below k=(d−1)m and otherwise simplicially identical to N(m,k−(d−1)m). Barycenters are independent of filtration parameter and commute with quotient rotation/reflection; hence exact PL maps and all integral persistence maps. Boundary cases m=1 and k=n−1 full simplex correctly handled. Reimplemented independent direct inclusion vs gap vs reduced face tests for all 896 triples n=2..24, all nontrivial d|n and k levels, 195,110 orbit-subset tests: all agree. Ordinary sphere homotopy labels are cited from 2014 primary work, not wrongly derived from finite tests alone.
